Answer: D
Reason: The chest X-ray shows complete opacification of the right hemithorax with a contralateral (leftward) mediastinal shift, which indicates a space-occupying lesion such as a massive pleural-based mass or tension effusion rather than atelectasis (which would cause an ipsilateral shift). Among the choices, a large right pleural-based mass best accounts for the total white-out and the significant push of mediastinal structures to the opposite side.
